groups.title: Course details
groups.instruction: Complete the notes below. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

parts.context: A man phones a college to enrol on an evening photography course.

transcript.text: Riverside College, enrolment office. Ms Chen speaking.
transcript.speaker: MS CHEN

transcript.text: Good evening. I'd like to join one of your evening courses, if there are still places available.
transcript.speaker: ALI

transcript.text: Certainly. May I ask whether you have taken a course at the college before?
transcript.speaker: MS CHEN

transcript.text: No, this is my first time. I work in an office during the day, but photography has always been my hobby, and I'd like to learn the technical side.
transcript.speaker: ALI

transcript.text: Yes, we have several. Which one are you interested in? And could I have your name, please?
transcript.speaker: MS CHEN

transcript.text: My name's Ali Rahmani. That's R-A-H-M-A-N-I. And I'd like the digital photography course.
transcript.speaker: ALI

transcript.text: Thank you. That one is very popular. The next course starts on the twelfth of October.
transcript.speaker: MS CHEN

transcript.text: That's perfect timing, because I'll have finished a big project at work by then.
transcript.speaker: ALI

transcript.text: Good. Evening courses suit people who work during the day, and we find that students support each other a lot.
transcript.speaker: MS CHEN

transcript.text: Great. Which evening is it?
transcript.speaker: ALI

transcript.text: It's on Wednesdays, from half past six until half past eight. It runs for ten weeks.
transcript.speaker: MS CHEN

transcript.text: Ten weeks is a good length. I was worried it would be too short.
transcript.speaker: ALI

transcript.text: Most people find it's just right, and many continue on to the advanced course in the spring.
transcript.speaker: MS CHEN

transcript.text: And how much does it cost? I saw ninety-five pounds on your website, but I'm not sure that was right.
transcript.speaker: ALI

transcript.text: That was last year's price. This year it's eighty-five pounds, and that includes the printing of your final portfolio.
transcript.speaker: MS CHEN

transcript.text: Good. Do I need to bring my own equipment?
transcript.speaker: ALI

transcript.text: Yes, you need your own camera. It doesn't have to be expensive, even a basic one is fine. The college provides the lights and the computers.
transcript.speaker: MS CHEN

transcript.text: A basic camera is fine, then. I have an old one that my father gave me, and I use it all the time.
transcript.speaker: ALI

transcript.text: That's a good start. The tutor will show you how to get the best from it, whatever model you have.
transcript.speaker: MS CHEN

transcript.text: What size is the class?
transcript.speaker: ALI

transcript.text: We take a maximum of twelve students, so that everyone gets attention from the tutor.
transcript.speaker: MS CHEN

transcript.text: And where does it take place?
transcript.speaker: ALI

transcript.text: In Room three-oh-four, in the Arts Building. That's on the third floor, and there's a lift. The tutor is Mr Davies, that's D-A-V-I-E-S.
transcript.speaker: MS CHEN

transcript.text: The third floor is fine. I'll be coming straight from work, so I'll probably be a little tired.
transcript.speaker: ALI

transcript.text: There's a coffee machine in the corridor, so you can get something before the lesson.
transcript.speaker: MS CHEN

transcript.text: Thank you. Is there parking?
transcript.speaker: ALI

transcript.text: There is, but the main car park is often full in the evening, so I'd suggest the north car park. It's a five-minute walk from the Arts Building.
transcript.speaker: MS CHEN

transcript.text: I'll do that. And how do I pay?
transcript.speaker: ALI

transcript.text: You can pay online or at the college office, but you need to pay at least one week before the start.
transcript.speaker: MS CHEN

transcript.text: I'll do it online tomorrow. Thank you very much for your help.
transcript.speaker: ALI

transcript.text: You'll receive a welcome email with a reading list and a map of the college.
transcript.speaker: MS CHEN

transcript.text: Perfect. I'm really looking forward to it. Goodbye.
transcript.speaker: ALI

transcript.text: Goodbye, Mr Rahmani.
transcript.speaker: MS CHEN
